adopted_parent: SW: X free 0/1 endpoint; Y calendar 0/.4/.6/.8/1; 24 baseline conceptual controls; SX WITH IY; five XY residual covariances; free SY residual
scope: four SX*IZ->SY latent interactions; SD observed-2012 moderation plus three resource group differences
eligibility: 2012 Z computable; independent samples; retain later unbalanced waves; structural undefined values are never filled
z_scale: 100*raw gap or SD / same-wave closeness mean; freeze observed-2012 mean and SD in each Z eligible sample; SD positive, signed gaps reversed

group_one_meanings.INC: positive personal income, not high income

pooling: all ten members admissible; each LMS family also passes MI01 start and integration checks bound to adopted attempt; fixed named contrasts per member then Rubin, complete-data df infinity
multiplicity: Holm family size four latent interactions and separately three H4 contrasts; missing tests stay missing; observed fallback family separate
direction: Unified adverse Z: positive delta corresponds to weakening prediction, negative delta to buffering prediction only where conditional slopes support those meanings; two-sided tests; no duplicate hypothesis count
h4_direction: Report delta0, delta1, gamma; simultaneous Bonferroni 95% intervals over nine contrasts; sensitivity label requires same direction and identified difference of magnitude
fallback: only failed latent branch gets E0/E1, except SD already prespecified for H4; no p-based switching
inference_boundary: conditional on fixed model and current imputation assumptions; no SESOI equivalence, no boundary LRT, no model-selection uncertainty included
delivery: reports, same-version docx/pdf, code, aggregate outputs, parameters and covariances; no private microdata or identifiers; each zip <=25000000 bytes
